snippet.title: TV-CHAN'S GREAT ESCAPE! GB - AVAILABLE NOW!!! - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
TV-Chan's Great Escape! GB IS OUT NOW!

https://nyktv.itch.io/tv-chans-great-escape-gb

A port/remake of the nesgame TV-Chan's Great Escape! (2023)
A harrowing new Game Boy adventure for 2024!

FEATURES:

​-30 engaging block-pushing puzzle levels
-An intriguing and mysterious story
-​Parental Rebellion!!!
-​A special credits page honoring all of our supportive patrons!

​​Embark on a thrilling journey and help TV-Chan make her Great Escape now on Gameboy, Gameboy Color, Analog Pocket, PC, & more!​
​
-

Boxart was created by  Fang of https://Fangsoft.itch.io

The Box's spine graphic is created by SealKode of https://sealkode-games.itch.io/  
(with minor-visual adjustments by yours truly)

This game was a labor of love and would not have been possible without the tremendous support of our patrons! If you enjoyed this work and would like behind-the-scenes looks and early builds of future games, consider becoming a patron today at: https://www.patreon.com/NykTV

Thank you so much!
-nyka TV
